findings.what: The chatindex URL handler hardcodes tab 0 as the chat list -- `tabs.selectedIndex = 0; UINavigationController *nc = tabs.viewControllers[0]; [nc popToRootViewControllerAnimated:NO];` -- but RootViewController installs the tabs as `@[contactsNC, chatsNC, settingsNC]` (src/RootViewController.m:58) with chats at index 1.
findings.failure: itglegacy://chatindex/3 switches to the Contacts tab and pushes TGChatViewController (or TGTopicsViewController) onto the Contacts navigation stack. The chat opens over the contacts list, the back button returns to Contacts, and every subsequent tap/, holdrow/ or profile/ URL that resolves `tabs.viewControllers[tabs.selectedIndex]` now operates on the Contacts stack. All scripted chat testing runs against the wrong tab.
findings.fix: Replace the two literal 0s at src/AppDelegate.m:300-301 with the chat-list tab index 1 (matching RootViewController's order), i.e. `tabs.selectedIndex = 1; UINavigationController *nc = tabs.viewControllers[1];`. Better: define a shared constant (e.g. `TGTabIndexChats = 1`) in RootViewController.h and use it in both files so the two cannot drift again.

findings.what: The auth-state switch only creates the login UI for TGAuthStateWaitPhoneNumber / Closed / LoggingOut. `case TGAuthStateWaitCode: [me.loginVC showCodeStepWithPhoneNumber:me.currentPhoneNumber];` and `case TGAuthStateWaitPassword: [me.loginVC showPasswordStep];` assume self.loginVC already exists, and TGAuthStateWaitRegistration falls into `default: break;`.
findings.failure: TDLib persists auth state in its database. Relaunching the app after the login code was requested (or after the code was accepted and 2FA is pending) makes handleAuthState (src/TGClient.m:438) emit authorizationStateWaitCode / WaitPassword as the very first state. At that moment self.loginVC is nil, because didFinishLaunchingWithOptions only called showLoadingUI. The two messages go to nil, no screen is ever installed, and the app sits on the grey spinner from showLoadingUI forever with no way to finish logging in short of deleting the TDLib database.
findings.fix: In src/AppDelegate.m:110-115, call `[me showLoginUI];` before addressing me.loginVC in the WaitCode, WaitPassword and WaitRegistration cases (showLoginUI is already idempotent -- it returns early when loginVC exists). Add an explicit `case TGAuthStateWaitRegistration:` that also calls showLoginUI instead of letting it hit `default`.

findings.what: A second, different `tab` handler exists: `if ([host isEqualToString:@"tab"]){ ... tabs.selectedIndex = MIN((NSUInteger)[arg integerValue], tabs.viewControllers.count - 1); }`. The first `tab` handler at line 268 already returns YES, so this block is unreachable.
findings.failure: Unreachable code that silently disagrees with the live handler: the dead one clamps out-of-range indices and does not pop to root, the live one rejects out-of-range indices and does pop. Anyone reading or editing the second copy changes nothing at runtime, and a future edit to it will appear to have no effect. `MIN((NSUInteger)[arg integerValue], ...)` in the dead copy would also turn itglegacy://tab/-1 into index 2 via unsigned wrap.
findings.fix: Delete src/AppDelegate.m:574-583 (the comment plus the whole second `if ([host isEqualToString:@"tab"])` block). Keep the handler at line 268.

findings.what: `@protocol TGScrollToTopTarget` / `- (void)scrollToTopRequested;` is declared here and dispatched at line 97-98 (`if ([controller respondsToSelector:@selector(scrollToTopRequested)]) [(id<TGScrollToTopTarget>)controller scrollToTopRequested];`), but no class in src/ implements scrollToTopRequested -- grep over src/*.m finds only these two lines.
findings.failure: Tapping the already-selected tab (the standard iOS scroll-to-top gesture, wired through TGTabBar -> tabBarSelectedItem:) always fails the respondsToSelector: check and does nothing. The feature the code is written for silently does not exist on any screen.
findings.fix: Either implement `- (void)scrollToTopRequested` on TGChatListViewController, TGContactsViewController and TGSettingsViewController (`[self.tableView setContentOffset:CGPointMake(0, -self.tableView.contentInset.top) animated:YES]`), or delete the protocol at src/RootViewController.m:14-16 and the else branch at lines 93-99.

findings.what: `[TGHacks setLayoutDelegateForContainerView:self.view.subviews[0] layoutDelegate:self.layoutDelegate];` (also re-run from reassociateLayoutDelegate on every viewDidLayoutSubviews). The association is only ever read by the swizzled -layoutSubviewsTG, and TGHacks swizzles exactly one class: `@[@[@"UILayoutContainerView", [TGLayoutContainerView class]]]` (src/TGHacks.m:61-62). self.view.subviews[0] of a UITabBarController is a UITransitionView, which is not swizzled.
findings.failure: The associated object on the transition view is set and retained on every layout pass but never read by anything, so it has no effect. The original 2013 source (TelegraphKit/TGHacks.m:329-332) also registered TGTransitionView, TGNavigationTransitionView and TGViewControllerWrapperView; that part was dropped in the port, leaving the caller half-wired.
findings.fix: Either drop the second association (src/RootViewController.m:29-30 and the reassociateLayoutDelegate/viewDidLayoutSubviews pair at 33-41), or restore the missing swizzle pairs in src/TGHacks.m:61-63 by adding `TGFullscreenContainerClass(TGTransitionView)` and an `@[@"UITransitionView", [TGTransitionView class]]` entry to classPairs.

findings.what: The touch/ handler reimplements TGTabBar's hit test with a hardcoded tab count: `int index = MAX(0, MIN((int)3 - 1, (int)(point.x / (view.frame.size.width / 3))));`. TGTabBar already has `- (int)indexForLocation:(CGPoint)location` (src/TGTabBar.m:90-95) which does the same arithmetic from self.buttonViews.count.
findings.failure: Two copies of the same formula, one of them with the tab count frozen at 3. Changing the number of tabs makes itglegacy://touch on the tab bar select the wrong tab while real finger taps still work, which reads as a UI bug rather than a harness bug. The copy also uses `point` in window coordinates without converting into the tab bar's space; that happens to be correct only because the bar sits at x=0 spanning the full width.
findings.fix: Declare `- (int)indexForLocation:(CGPoint)location;` in src/TGTabBar.h and in src/AppDelegate.m:362 call `[(TGTabBar *)view indexForLocation:[view convertPoint:point fromView:nil]]` instead of the inline expression.

findings.what: The URL-scheme doc comment states `itglegacy://tab/N switch to tab N (0 chats, 1 contacts, 2 settings)`, but RootViewController orders the tabs contacts(0), chats(1), settings(2) (src/RootViewController.m:58) and defaults to index 1.
findings.failure: Anyone scripting the device from this comment sends itglegacy://tab/0 expecting the chat list and lands on Contacts; this is almost certainly the origin of the chatindex bug above. Documentation and code disagree about the same data.
findings.fix: Correct the comment at src/AppDelegate.m:232 (and the duplicate line 231 entry) to read `0 contacts, 1 chats, 2 settings`.
